scientific_intent.scientific_task: Evaluate Multiple Debye-Huckel screened atom potentials on gridpoints
scientific_intent.governing_method: Sum q/r exp(-kappa(r-size))/(1+kappa size) with scalarpre1
accuracy_needs: finite positive potential for positive charges
scientific_intent.input_regime: Separated dyadic atom/grid positions, positivecharges, pre1=1,xkappa=.125,size.125to.5
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float32distance, exp or fast-exp, accumulation; Float64CPUoracle separately
scientific_intent.community_use_case: APBS-inspired molecular electrostatic field evaluation, not full Poisson-Boltzmann solver validation

summary.conclusion: Default exponential term necessarilyoverflowsFloat32forpositivecharges; originalfabsf(inf-inf)>tol isfalse, so PASS alone cannot confirm finite accuracy. Source-derived range proof, not observed GPU default failure.

scientific_witness_evidence.interpretation: Additional scoped mathematical/invariant evidence; complements full dual-reference checks, not a proof over all inputs.
